meta.source: ORCA simplified bounding polygons for gazetted Indian marine protected areas
meta.warning: Simplified rectangular approximations of real protected areas. Extents are indicative, not gazetted boundaries. Production consumes the authoritative WDPA / MoEFCC protected-area dataset.

properties.name: Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park
properties.rule: Fishing, anchoring and coral collection prohibited inside the core park area.

properties.name: Marine National Park & Sanctuary, Gulf of Kachchh
properties.rule: Mechanised fishing and coral/mangrove extraction prohibited; entry regulated by permit.

properties.name: Malvan (Marine) Wildlife Sanctuary
properties.rule: Trawling prohibited; traditional fishing permitted in the buffer zone.

properties.name: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park, Wandoor
properties.rule: Fishing prohibited; entry by permit only.

properties.name: Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary (Olive Ridley nesting)
properties.rule: Fishing banned within the no-fishing zone during the Olive Ridley nesting season (1 Nov - 31 May).
